title: Every slide in this deck takes its colours and type from one Vellum theme
subtitle: A PowerPoint template that Canva can import: Vellum theme colours and fonts, ten layouts, thirteen example slides, light and dark
data: Figures from the Vellum gallery; UN World Population Prospects (2024) and Ember (2026) with the Energy Institute (2025), processed by Our World in Data, CC BY 4.0
alt: A 16:9 PowerPoint deck in the Vellum style, light and dark: a title slide, two section slides on the card, the Keeling curve and the life-expectancy small multiples as claim-and-figure slides, the adaptive landscape and its heat-map twin side by side, a native line chart of life expectancy in Asia, Africa and Europe with end labels, a native column chart of world electricity by source in 2000 and 2025, a big number (42.6 % low-carbon electricity in 2025), three stat tiles, a regional table, a closing slide and a slide on using the template in PowerPoint and Canva.
note: Theme colours, fonts, master and layouts are set in the .pptx itself; previews exported by PowerPoint. Downloads: downloads/vellum-slides-light.pptx and downloads/vellum-slides-dark.pptx.
